encounters.weakness: Fire Dagger (Player Weapon) - 2x damage on fire attacks from the dagger; takes 30% more damage when hit with flame burst attacks with the dagger or flame spikes in range of 3m.

Soot Shard (Pickup from previous encounter) - When the shard is activated (held near enemy), it triggers a 4-second 'Fire Still' that suppresses all fire-based attacks and reduces the Sentinel's fire resistance by 30% for 5 seconds. The Sentinel is immune to fire attacks during this time, but cannot attack during 'Fire Still'.

Soot Shard (Used as projectile directly into the heart's core — only works if the shard was used within the last 15 seconds of the prior fight or picked up in the second encounter). When the Soot Shard is thrown into the heart's core, it detonates and causes a massive fire wave that deals 200 damage and reduces the heart's fire resistance by 50%. This action must be performed in the first 15 seconds after the heart appears to be vulnerable (a visible crack appears in its chest).
The Whistle of the Windbeast (player weapon) – Gloop shivers when the whistle is blown, reducing its damage by 50% and slowing its movement.
Windbeast Feather (pickup from previous encounter) – when the feather is held, Petalsting's petals freeze mid-flutter and it becomes immobile for 2 seconds.
Sunlit Sparkle Seed (pickup from previous encounter) – if the player has planted the seed and the light is active, Murmur's voice is silenced for 3 seconds and its attack range is reduced by half.
Holy Sword of St. Aelis (Direct Holy Blade Strike) — 25% damage increase on melee hits. The Wraith is immune to fire or non-holy attacks. Only the player's holy sword can pierce its shadow armor.

Fragments of Saint Vael (Must be activated within 3 seconds of the knight's attack). When active, it takes 50% damage from all melee attacks. Cannot be stunned — must be hit with a physical strike while Fragments glow. The knight is resistant to holy magic, so only physical hits work when Fragments are active.

Cleansing Flame of Orvus — when used, it deals 80% extra damage and causes the enemy to shatter into soul fragments for 3 seconds. The Echoed Guard mimics player attacks and counters with holy magic. Only the Cleansing Flame can break its mimicry and trigger soul shattering.

The Mirror Shard (pickup) - when struck by a reflected beam of light, the Archivist momentarily freezes and takes 2x damage. Use the Mirror Shard to reflect a beam directly into its core vision node (a pulsing red eye in the center of its chest). Only effective after the player has used an illusion to misdirect it with a 'false reflection'.

The Void Stinger (player weapon) - when the Void Stinger is used at full charge with a 'reality fracture' effect, it creates a temporary tear in the spire's illusion field. The enemy's illusions begin to bleed through—revealing its true form. After 3 seconds, it drops a 'Sorrow Shard' (a glowing fragment of the Spire's core). The player must immediately use the Void Stinger to strike the exposed core before it reforms. Failure results in the enemy reactivating all illusions and gaining +50% illusion resistance for 20 seconds.

The Mirror Shard (pickup from first encounter) - when the player uses the Mirror Shard to reflect a beam directly into the Veil-Singer's 'chord node' (a floating, golden orb at its chest), it causes a harmonic dissonance. The Veil-Singer stumbles and takes 500 damage. This only works if the Mirror Shard was *collected during the first encounter* and was used at least once. If not, the weakness is nullified and the boss gains immunity to all illusion-based attacks for the duration of the fight. The Mirror Shard must be actively in hand during the attack to work. If not, the boss will unleash a reality storm that shatters the player's illusions and replaces them with a perfect copy of the player—now a permanent enemy, increasing health by 200 and gaining resistance to the Void Stinger.
Guardian's Staff (calming pulse disables their hum and movement)
Crystal Shard of Stillness (placed near the spirit causes it to freeze and retreat)
Crystal Shard of Stillness (must be placed on the pedestal at its feet to trigger its collapse into mist; only effective once per fight)
The Bloodmaw Greatsword (bleeds when struck, causing Gorgon's Spine to shriek in pain and lose 10 damage per second for 3 seconds).
The Fang of the Wounded Sky (when the weapon is equipped, the Echo-Skull's voice echoes back, causing it to stutter and lose 10% damage per second for 4 seconds after every attack).

The Sundered Chain of the First Blood (must be activated during the fight — if the player uses it, the Heart of Riven's corruption reverses for 15 seconds, causing it to lose 15% damage per second and all attacks to deal half damage for 3 seconds. This only triggers if the Sundered Chain was obtained in a previous encounter and equipped at the start of the fight).
inventory: Sundered Chain of the First Blood

encounters.weakness: The player's Bone Dagger (when used with the 'Soul Dust' vial from the first encounter, damage increases by 50%)
inventory: Bone Dagger (Unstable - deals necrotic damage, can shatter on impact)

encounters.weakness: Bone Shard (a shard from the first encounter's corpse) — when equipped, reduces enemy damage by 30% and slows their movement speed.
inventory: Bone Dagger (Unstable - deals necrotic damage, can shatter on impact)

encounters.weakness: Soul Dust (Purified) — if used on the final enemy, it triggers a soul resonance, instantly reducing the enemy's health by 40% and freezing all movement for 3 seconds. This must be used *after* the Bone Shard has been equipped and after defeating the Flesh-Eater Ghoul.
inventory: Bone Dagger (Unstable - deals necrotic damage, can shatter on impact)

encounters.weakness: Player's longbow with wind-shear resonance (resonant arrow strikes cause 2x damage, but require 10% ammo to charge, causing a 5-second cooldown on the weapon).
Frost-Resonance Arrow (must be fired directly into the head; any miss or indirect hit fails. Affects only the first enemy form).
Shattered Mirror Shard (if held and activated, the Watcher freezes for 3 seconds. The player must land a hit with the Frost-Resonance Arrow during this freeze to win).
Coolant Injector (pickup from prior encounter — actually, this is a trick! The player must first *acquire* the injector to have the weakness. See note.)
inventory: Pulse Welder (high-heat, short-range energy tool used to weld and melt targets)

encounters.weakness: Pulse Welder (player's weapon) — when fired at full power, inflicts 180 damage and causes temporary bio-melt (stuns enemy for 3 seconds).
inventory: Pulse Welder (high-heat, short-range energy tool used to weld and melt targets)

encounters.weakness: Self-Regen Nanite Patch (pickup from second encounter). When used on enemy, reduces health by 50% and causes a 10-second destabilization effect, breaking its gravity field (player can then reposition safely).
inventory: Pulse Welder (high-heat, short-range energy tool used to weld and melt targets)

encounters.weakness: Chrono-Spark weapon (pulse frequency: 7-8 Hz triggers time-dampening effect, slowing enemy by 40%)
Temporal Fragment (a single use item from previous encounter; when held, the predator is slowed by 50% and takes 30% more damage in the next 5 seconds)

Temporal Shard (Phase Core) — when activated, the construct is frozen in a single frame for 3 seconds, allowing the player to deal critical damage. This ability requires the player to possess the Temporal Shard from the second encounter and use it during the final attack sequence.

Overcharged Storm Gauntlet (Player's weapon must be at 100% charge to disable it). If overcharged, it emits a destabilizing surge that disrupts the AI's storm patterns and causes it to freeze momentarily (3 seconds). After that, it enters a rage phase and attacks faster and with greater damage. Must be used *before* the enemy activates its full form. Player must manage overcharge carefully—overcharging too much causes self-damage (30% damage per overcharge).
inventory: Storm Gauntlet - a sentient energy conduit that channels lightning and wind, but can overheat and destabilize if overcharged.

encounters.weakness: Conductor Crystalline Core (picked up from Storm Shaper's wreckage). The Warden's core is made of unstable quantum material. When the Core is placed in its central node (a rotating crystal in the tower), it emits a resonance pulse that freezes the Warden in place for 3 seconds and deals 200% damage to its body. This must be used *within 5 seconds of activation* to trigger the effect. If the Warden detects the core being used, it duplicates itself into a mirror version that attacks from behind, increasing damage by 20% and speed by 50%.
inventory: Storm Gauntlet - a sentient energy conduit that channels lightning and wind, but can overheat and destabilize if overcharged.

encounters.weakness: Conductor Crystalline Core (must be placed in its central node to disrupt its frequency. Only one core can be used. When placed, the Sky-Devourer's energy field collapses for 10 seconds, and it takes 30% damage. After that, it enters a chaotic phase where it generates 3 storm waves that deal massive burst damage. If the core is not used within 20 seconds, it activates a full-scale 'devour cycle' that consumes the player's health and resets the storm cycle. The core must be used *exactly once* during the fight to win. Failure results in the player being absorbed into the core and losing all progress. Only works if the player has the Conductor Crystalline Core and it has been used in a prior encounter (validity check).
inventory: Storm Gauntlet - a sentient energy conduit that channels lightning and wind, but can overheat and destabilize if overcharged.

encounters.weakness: The Twin-Phase Resonator emits harmonic pulses that disrupt the Strider's passive replication. When the Resonator is active, the Strider briefly freezes and becomes vulnerable for 3 seconds.
inventory: Twin-Phase Resonator (a compact, hand-held device that emits harmonic pulses to disrupt energy fields or unlock systems)

encounters.weakness: The Circuit Sentinel detects and amplifies EM noise. If the player uses the Harmonic Fragment while firing the Twin-Phase Resonator, the Sentinel becomes disoriented and freezes for 2 seconds. This is because the harmonic frequency matches a dormant frequency in its core system.
inventory: Twin-Phase Resonator (a compact, hand-held device that emits harmonic pulses to disrupt energy fields or unlock systems)

encounters.weakness: The System Ghost is a projection of the Silent Protocol's corrupted AI. It only attacks when the player uses a physical weapon. The Twin-Phase Resonator's harmonic pulse can trigger a phase shift in the ghost — when fired directly at it, it flickers and becomes vulnerable for 3 seconds. However, it must be used in conjunction with the Signal Node to activate the pulse properly (requires 100% signal lock).
inventory: Twin-Phase Resonator (a compact, hand-held device that emits harmonic pulses to disrupt energy fields or unlock systems)

encounters.weakness: Phase through its shadow form using the player's Shadowblade. The blade's phase effect disrupts its flicker-movement, making it vulnerable to one hit during the phase window. This phase window is only visible when the blade is active (activated by pressing 'X').
inventory: Shadowblade (a plasma-tipped, phase-dampening blade that leaves faint afterimages and can phase through shadows).

encounters.weakness: The Echo-Drifter duplicates itself every 3 seconds. Each copy is identical but moves slightly out of sync. The Shadowblade's phase ability can only disrupt one copy at a time. However, if the player uses the Shade Core Fragment (from Encounter 1) *while* the phase attack is active, it creates a temporary 'phase sync' — allowing the blade to phase *through* both copies simultaneously, exposing them to a single critical hit. This requires precise timing and is only possible during the first 3 seconds of the encounter.
inventory: Shadowblade (a plasma-tipped, phase-dampening blade that leaves faint afterimages and can phase through shadows).

encounters.weakness: The Synapse Hive is vulnerable to the **Shade Core Fragment** — the specific pickup from the first encounter. When the player holds the Shade Core Fragment *and* performs a full phase attack (Shadowblade activated) while the Hive is in its 'Reconstruction Phase' (a 10-second pulse every 60 seconds), it emits a resonant frequency that destabilizes its core. The player must use the Shade Core Fragment to trigger a phase pulse during the exact 10-second window, causing a 30% damage burst. The Hive will only enter the Reconstruction Phase if the player has used the Shade Core Fragment at least once in the past 10 minutes. If the player fails to use it during that window, the Hive activates a 'Pattern Lock' — rendering all attacks ineffective for 20 seconds.
inventory: Shadowblade (a plasma-tipped, phase-dampening blade that leaves faint afterimages and can phase through shadows).

encounters.weakness: The Tear of Aether (inflicts acid burn that corrodes their internal circuitry). When the vial is fired in a wide arc, it causes a feedback loop that disrupts their power core and reduces their health by 30% in 1.5 seconds.

The Bio-Lumen Vial (when pulsed, causes a temporary 'light hemorrhage' that destabilizes their vision and causes them to misfire their energy lances). The pulse wave reduces their attack accuracy by 40% and lowers their health by 20% per second for 3 seconds after the pulse.

The Ferrous Resonance Shard (when thrown into the core's pulsing node, it triggers a resonance collapse. The shard must be used *within 3 seconds* of impact to initiate a 60-second vulnerability window where the Architect is weakened by 50% and its energy shields flicker. If the shard is used improperly, it causes a feedback loop and drains player health by 30%.)

The Glimmer Stinger (light pulse) – when the Glimmer Stinger is used directly at the Jiggler, it triggers a 'jiggle burst' that knocks it back and exposes its underside, making it vulnerable to follow-up attacks or environmental triggers.
inventory: Glimmer Stinger – a flickering, light-based weapon that emits soft pulses and can be used to disrupt or distract enemies.

encounters.weakness: Squiggle Goo – when the Fizzy Fawn is hit with the Squiggle Goo, it emits a loud 'bloop' and collapses, stunned. The goo must be thrown directly into its eyes or near its snout to work.
inventory: Glimmer Stinger – a flickering, light-based weapon that emits soft pulses and can be used to disrupt or distract enemies.

encounters.weakness: Squiggle Goo – the Gloop must be struck with the Squiggle Goo applied directly to its core. When hit, it shivers, becomes translucent, and collapses into a soft, happy blob that giggles and floats away. This completes the level and restores the planet's balance.
inventory: Glimmer Stinger – a flickering, light-based weapon that emits soft pulses and can be used to disrupt or distract enemies.

encounters.weakness: Tectonic Core Spike (TCS) — the spike's gravity pulse can trigger a resonance cascade that destabilizes the Drift's core structure, causing a 40% damage multiplier when used in the right timing (only once per encounter).

Fracture Resonance Fragment — if the player uses this fragment in the first 10 seconds of combat, the Pendulum's phase shifts, reducing its gravity pull and causing it to swing wildly, making it vulnerable to 200% damage from the player's Tectonic Core Spike. This ability is triggered only once per encounter.

Stellar Tectonite Shard — if the player throws this shard into the Overlord's central pulse core during a moment of stillness (when the Overlord is not actively attacking), the core collapses, triggering a 3-second window where the Overlord is vulnerable to **double damage** from the Tectonic Core Spike. This only works once per encounter. The shard must be used before the Overlord shifts its phase.
